query: WITH paid AS (SELECT e.business_id, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments.ledger_entry p WHERE p.kind = 'charge' AND p.business_id = e.business_id AND p.id <> e.id AND p.recorded_at <= e.recorded_at AND p.recorded_at >= e.recorded_at - interval '60 days') AS again FROM payments.ledger_entry e WHERE e.kind = 'charge' AND e.job_id = ANY($1) AND e.recorded_at >= $2 AND e.recorded_at < $3) SELECT count(DISTINCT business_id) FILTER (WHERE again) AS "part!", count(DISTINCT business_id) AS "whole!" FROM paid
